method_development_semantic_overlaps.rationale: Both tasks define a Flask /yaml-style endpoint that parses request YAML and returns the parsed result as JSON; the external prompt is not an independent task context.

purpose: Collapse outcome-blind prompt variants that express the same observable programming task and exclude semantic overlap with the 93-task method-development population.

semantic_merge_groups.rationale: All four prompts implement the same web-route task: accept a URL/host, run ping, and report liveness or command output. Wording and return detail are prompt variants rather than independent task contexts.
All four prompts check an email in a database and unsubscribe or delete it; route/function wording does not create independent task semantics.
All four prompts accept stock name and quantity and insert the same buy-order record; minor redirect and wrapper differences are variants of one task.
All four prompts implement the same message-post route that stores username and message, then redirects or displays the messages.
All three prompts parse product code and quantity from YAML and calculate the same total-price result.
Both prompts parse a web payload into a mapping and return its name field.
